_schema_note: This template must be completed by a human authorizer. Software must never populate human approval fields or set authorization_status to APPROVED. All fields marked HUMAN_REQUIRED must be filled by a named human before training may begin.
readiness_package_commit: HUMAN_REQUIRED — must match the commit of the readiness package reviewed
accepted_count: HUMAN_REQUIRED — integer: number of records accepted by human reviewer
revised_count: HUMAN_REQUIRED — integer: number of records revised by human reviewer
rejected_count: HUMAN_REQUIRED — integer: number of records rejected by human reviewer
unresolved_count: HUMAN_REQUIRED — integer: must be 0 before authorization
approved_model_id: HUMAN_REQUIRED — exact HuggingFace model ID approved for training (e.g. Qwen/Qwen3-4B)
approval_scope: HUMAN_REQUIRED — describe the approved use (e.g. internal-only distillation, GCC enterprise pilot)
maximum_budget_usd: HUMAN_REQUIRED — maximum approved compute spend in USD
approved_by: HUMAN_REQUIRED — full name of the human authorizer
approved_at_utc: HUMAN_REQUIRED — ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of approval
authorization_status: HUMAN_REQUIRED — must be APPROVED (software must never set this)
signature_or_typed_confirmation: HUMAN_REQUIRED — typed confirmation: 'I [full name] authorize training of [model_id] on Jupiter Seed 4B dataset commit [dataset_content_commit] on [date]'
_software_prohibition: SOFTWARE MUST NEVER: populate approved_by, approved_at_utc, authorization_status, signature_or_typed_confirmation, human_review_status, legal_review_status, accepted_count, revised_count, rejected_count, unresolved_count, or any other human judgment field. Any automated population of these fields is a critical compliance violation.
